items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I can't think of his last name. Morty, yeah, that's right.

ctx.x: I can't think of his last name. Morty, yeah, that's right. Anyway, Charlie said, "Get him. Tell him I said come here." So I said, "You tell him. I ain't gonna tell him nothin'." I said, "He don't like me; at least he didn't get no room." I said, "I had to walk all night damn near before I found a place to sleep." So when I went to sleep I wasn't thinking about getting up to make no ten o'clock rehearsal."

So he fired him right on the spot. He said, "How come you didn't have the rooms reserved for Holland and McGhee." He said, "You didn't tell me to make them reservations." So Charlie said, "Well, they're in the band, ain't they, fool?" Oh boy, it was something else, man.
